conventions: Conventional abridged atomic weights, rounded to three decimals; uncertainty digits are not appended.
Brackets contain a representative isotope mass number, not a standard atomic weight.
Lu/Lr group 3 convention; other f-series elements have no assigned group 1–18.
Unknown/predicted bulk properties of At, Fr and Z>=99 are not presented as measured.
Gas densities are reference values near 0 °C, 1 atm, not at 20 °C.
Carbon has no normal boiling/melting point at 1 atm; helium does not solidify at 1 atm.
